tools.name: show_inspection
tools.description: Answer a restaurant question with a card or a map. Use a restaurant name for a card, or a violation term plus a city for a map (for example pest inspections in Milwaukee). Hosts that support MCP Apps render the card or map inline. The text result still names the matches for hosts that only show text

tools.name: get_milwaukee_inspections
tools.description: Return one MCP App card of the worst Milwaukee restaurants. Pass limit 500 so the card ranks a wide recent window. One call is enough. Do not page, and do not quote inspector comments.

tools.name: get_city_inspections
tools.description: Return one MCP App card of the worst restaurants in chicago, nyc, minneapolis, milwaukee, austin, or denver. Pass limit 500. One call is enough. Use this for a bad or nasty place in a city. Do not page, and do not quote inspector comments.

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Look up a restaurant by name and return an MCP App card for each match. Use this when someone asks to see a named place, such as Auntie Anne's in Milwaukee. The card is the answer. Do not rewrite inspection comments.

tools.name: find_nearby_restaurants
tools.description: Find restaurants near a point or address and return an MCP App card for each. Default radius is a quarter mile.
